name: savoney
description: Savoney — a full-stack personal finance platform. TypeScript monorepo.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @savoney/shared && npm run build -w @savoney/server && npm run build -w @savoney/client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @savoney/server && npm run test -w @savoney/client
scripts.test:server: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @savoney/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @savoney/server && npm run typecheck -w @savoney/client
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @savoney/server
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
